This tool performs semantic retrieval within the configured knowledge bases and returns the knowledge snippets most relevant to the user question.
It applies to product documentation Q&A, operation guide retrieval, rule knowledge lookup, and similar scenarios.
If the current question clearly depends on knowledge base content, call this tool before answering.

Returned result structure:
1. The returned object contains:
- matches: hit result list
- bestMatch: best hit result, with the same structure as an item in matches

- datasetId: knowledge base ID
- datasetName: knowledge base name
- handler: knowledge base handler name
- chunkId: hit chunk ID
- sourceId: source record ID
- objectId: business object ID
- objectType: business object type
- name: business object name
- content: matched text snippet
- status: chunk status
- score: match score
- meta: knowledge base custom extension information
